messages:
Raj Patel: Heads-up: all-hands on Friday 9am PT, 40m tight. Two main callouts: a short exec preview of an updated travel & external-communications policy, and a quick incident summary + next steps from last week's regional gateway outage. Drop 1-2 bullets if you need a slot.

Raj Patel: Draft agenda:
• 6m — company snapshot + hiring pulse
• 8m — exec policy preview (travel & external comms)
• 10m — outage summary: timeline, mitigations, and temporary mitigations (eng/sre)
• 8m — product demo: Dedicated burst policy changes
• 8m — open Q&A (collected + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room F + Zoom link. Live captions enabled. Recording will be on. If you need an embargo on anything, DM me ASAP. :memo:

Maya Chen: For the policy preview, can we please mark the travel piece as "preview"? Folks may need to prep comms.

Raj Patel: Yes — its preview only. We'll share the draft doc during the meeting and accept feedback; formal rollout depends on legal + people ops signoff.

Liam O'Connor: About the outage summary: will we publish the RCA in incidents after the all-hands? We should avoid repeating in public recording until the postmortem is ready.

Zara Ahmed: Good point. Proposal: give a high-level timeline in the all-hands recording, and note that the RCA + action items will land in #incidents and the postmortem doc after internal review. Clara, can you coordinate?

Clara Gomez: Yep. All-hands recording will include the high-level summary only. Well add a pinned link to the postmortem in the recording post once it's finalized. If anyone needs a segment removed before posting, flag it by Thu EOD.

Raj Patel: Also, engineering will present the mitigation steps and the temporary routing change that reduced error rates. No deep logs in the public clip.

Maya Chen: For the policy piece, can we include a one-slide FAQ: main changes + who to contact for exceptions? I can draft.

Raj Patel: Please do. One slide only. Put it in the shared folder: https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/fragments.

Emily Wong: Q&A intake form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands/questions-preview — submit by Thu 5pm. We'll prioritize incident-related questions and legal/policies.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder scheduled — "All-Hands: Fri 9am PT" will post 24h and 1h before the event.

Liam O'Connor: Engineering ask: include a single chart showing error-rate curve + the low-risk rollback plan (one line). Helps oncall and partners.

Raj Patel: Good ask. Liam + Maya coordinate on the single slide. Keep it chart + one rollback line.

Zara Ahmed: If teams want separate deep-dive postmortems or policy office hours, we'll spin up follow-ups after the all-hands. Mention that during the meeting.

Clara Gomez: Recording will be posted to #all-hands-posts with a short blurb and a 2-3min highlight clip focusing on the product demo. Full recording + transcript available to employees.

Raj Patel: Thanks all — keep submissions concise. See you Friday. :rocket:
